result.rationale: The migration inserts raw legacy values ('#{h}') from the embeddable_hosts site setting, which per the updated spec in this diff could include 'https://example.com/1234' or 'http://discourse.org'. EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? matches via `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, so rows containing schemes/paths never match, breaking previously working embed hosts after upgrade. The model's before_validation normalization is bypassed since inserts are raw SQL.
